own_solution.law: Calorimetry energy balance: dT_w = m1 c1 (T1 - T2)/(m1 c1 + m2 c2)

defect_reasons.other: T4800 ('is poured into this container') does not say whether the water is added before or after the exchange with the block; the intended reading (present during the exchange, at 293 K) is the natural one but not the only one.
